name: Guildmaster
source:
An adventurer's guild "Amakakeru Oyou" (天駆ける雄羊) operates from a pub in the outskirts. The Guildmaster cum pub owner Neil and his daughter Lusit run the businesses. This guild is now faced with an existential crisis.

The remote town of Dantor is situated on the foothills; it was formerly a massive mining complex run by the dwarves, but with their disappearance the town is now a hotspot for adventurers looking to get rich quick from what is now an enormous underground labyrinth. Amakakeru Oyou was but one guild which kept the mass of ambitious adventurers in control, but the retirement of capable adventurers and the rapid rise of the formidable rival guild, "Kokuyou no Tora" (黒曜の虎) has contributed to Hitsuji running at a loss in recent times.

Everything came to a head the previous month when the notice revoking the business license was delivered to the struggling guild. The town of Dantor only permits officially licensed guilds to operate so as things stand Oyou is on the verge of collapse. To renew the business license, Oyou has to produce tangible results within a few months.

During this time of crisis, the leading guild breadwinner, the skilled warrior Edgar, has his strength drained by a mysterious monster whilst exploring and is severely weakened to the point he cannot continue his trade. For the remaining guild members, this disaster is the last straw precipitating their exodus. Edgar remains as the sole registered adventurer of Oyou.

At this juncture Lusit offers Edgar the position of new Guildmaster. Lusit's reasoning considers her father's advanced age and the effect of having Edgar with his fame as a skilled warrior take the reins, which would encourage young adventurers to gather at the pub. Edgar, who still had lingering regrets over his career-ending accident, thought about his present physical condition and his desire to pay back the guild which he had grown fond of and decided to take up Lusit's offer to become the new Guildmaster of Amakakeru Oyou.

And thus, the ex-adventurer Edgar begins his new life as a Guildmaster.

[Translated from official website]
translation:
冒险者公会“天翔雄羊”在郊区一间酒馆里经营。公会长兼酒馆老板尼尔，与女儿露希特共同打理生意。如今，这个公会面临生死存亡危机。

偏远小镇丹托尔坐落在山麓，曾是矮人经营的巨大采矿综合体。随着矮人消失，小镇如今成为冒险者的聚集地，他们想从庞大的地下迷宫中快速发财。天翔雄羊只是负责控制这群野心勃勃冒险者的公会之一；但有能力的冒险者退休，加上强敌“黑曜之虎”迅速崛起，导致雄羊近来一直亏损。

上个月，经营困难的公会收到吊销营业执照通知，事情彻底恶化。丹托尔只允许持官方执照的公会运营，因此雄羊已濒临崩溃。想要续期营业执照，雄羊必须在几个月内拿出实绩。

危机期间，公会主要收入来源、技艺高超的战士埃德加在探索时被神秘怪物吸走力量，虚弱到无法继续冒险。对剩下的公会成员而言，这场灾难成了压垮骆驼的最后一根稻草，他们纷纷离开。埃德加成了雄羊唯一登记在册的冒险者。

此时，露希特向埃德加提出担任新公会长。露希特考虑到父亲年事已高，也认为让以技艺高超闻名的埃德加掌舵，能够吸引年轻冒险者来到酒馆。埃德加仍对结束冒险生涯的事故感到遗憾，也思考着自己的身体状况，以及报答这个令自己产生感情的公会的愿望，最终接受露希特的邀请，成为天翔雄羊的新公会长。

就这样，前冒险者埃德加开始了公会长的新生活。

（译自官方网站）
